jobs.description:
Situé à Château-d’Œx, à 1000 mètres d’altitude, le Pôle Santé Pays-d’Enhaut offre un large éventail de prestations hospitalières, d’hébergement, d’accompagnement de la personne âgée, ainsi que des soins à domicile. Selon l’approche dite de soins intégrés, cette organisation novatrice représente une opportunité pour les professionnel·le·s de la santé de travailler au sein de petites équipes multidisciplinaires, pour une meilleure continuité des soins et en réponse aux besoins de santé de la population du Pays-d’Enhaut.
 Au cœur d’un environnement naturel privilégié, le Pays-d’Enhaut est réputé pour la qualité de son cadre de vie et offre un très large éventail d’activités sportives, de loisirs et culturelles, à vivre été comme hiver!
 Dans le cadre de notre mission de formation, nous invitons les médecin assistant intéresser par notre institution à déposer leur candidature via cette annonce

Médecin assistant·e

Votre Mission:

• Prise en charge des patients de la division aiguë et au service des urgences sous la supervision d'un médecin cadre

• Assurer le suivi administratif des patients pris en charge dans les différents secteurs hospitaliers

• Participation au tournus de garde des médecins-assistants

• Participation à la formation continue médicale et interdisciplinaires
 Votre Profil:

• Diplôme de médecin suisse ou reconnaissance MEBEKO

• intérêt marqué pour la médecine interne

• 1 à 2 ans d'expérience professionnelle en Suisse

• Sens de l'initiative

• curiosité

• Bon sens relationnel
 Nous offrons :

• Une participation au développement d’un modèle de soins intégrés, impliquant la coordination et la collaboration de différents professionnels de la santé

• Un travail dans un environnement agréable, au sein d’une structure à taille humaine

• Les avantages de la vie en montagne tout en restant proche de centres urbains (à découvrir sous www.alpesvaudoises.ch/fr/stories/paysdenhaut)

• Des conditions de travail conformes à la CCT ASMAV-FHV

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Situato a Château-d’Œx, a 1000 metri di altitudine, il Pôle Santé Pays-d’Enhaut offre un ampio ventaglio di prestazioni ospedaliere, alloggi, accompagnamento della persona anziana, nonché cure domiciliari. Secondo l’approccio detto di cure integrate, questa organizzazione innovativa rappresenta un’opportunità per i professionisti della salute di lavorare all’interno di piccoli team multidisciplinari, per una migliore continuità delle cure e in risposta alle esigenze di salute della popolazione del Pays-d’Enhaut. Nel cuore di un ambiente naturale privilegiato, il Pays-d’Enhaut è rinomato per la qualità del suo stile di vita e offre un’ampia gamma di attività sportive, ricreative e culturali, da vivere sia in estate che in inverno! Nell’ambito della nostra missione di formazione, invitiamo i medici assistenti interessati alla nostra istituzione a presentare la loro candidatura tramite questa inserzione. Medico assistente La tua Missione: - Gestione dei pazienti della divisione acuta e del pronto soccorso sotto la supervisione di un medico di riferimento - Assicurare il follow-up amministrativo dei pazienti presi in carico nei vari settori ospedalieri - Partecipazione al turno di guardia dei medici assistenti - Partecipazione alla formazione medica continua e interdisciplinare Il tuo Profilo: - Laurea in medicina svizzera o riconoscimento MEBEKO - Forte interesse per la medicina interna - Spirito di iniziativa - Curiosità - Buone capacità relazionali
• Offriamo: - Un contributo allo sviluppo di un modello di cure integrate, che coinvolge la coordinazione e la collaborazione di diversi professionisti della salute - Un lavoro in un ambiente piacevole, all’interno di una struttura a misura d’uomo - I vantaggi della vita in montagna pur rimanendo vicini ai centri urbani (da scoprire su www.alpesvaudoises.ch/fr/stories/paysdenhaut) - Condizioni di lavoro conformi alla CCT ASMAV-FHV Contatto Grazie per inviarci il tuo dossier completo (CV, lettera di motivazione, diplomi, riconoscimenti MEBEKO se necessario e certificati di lavoro) tramite Jobup.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description Located in Château-d’Œx, at 1000 meters altitude, the Pôle Santé Pays-d’Enhaut offers a wide range of hospital services, accommodation, elderly care, as well as home care. According to the so-called integrated care approach, this innovative organization presents an opportunity for health professionals to work within small multidisciplinary teams, ensuring better continuity of care and responding to the health needs of the Pays-d’Enhaut population. In the heart of a privileged natural environment, Pays-d’Enhaut is renowned for the quality of its living environment and offers a very broad range of sports, leisure, and cultural activities, to be enjoyed both summer and winter! As part of our training mission, we invite interested medical assistants to apply through this advertisement. Medical Assistant Your Mission: - Managing patients in the acute division and emergency department under the supervision of a senior physician - Ensuring administrative follow-up of patients managed in various hospital sectors - Participating in the on-call rotation for medical assistants - Participating in continuous medical and interdisciplinary training Your
• Profile: - Swiss medical degree or MEBEKO recognition - Strong interest in internal medicine - Initiative and proactive attitude - Curiosity - Good interpersonal skills We Offer: - Participation in developing an integrated care model involving coordination and collaboration among various health professionals - Work in a pleasant environment within a small-sized structure - The advantages of mountain life while remaining close to urban centers (discover more at www.alpesvaudoises.ch/fr/stories/paysdenhaut) - Working conditions compliant with the CCT ASMAV-FHV Contact Please send your complete application (CV, cover letter, diplomas, MEBEKO recognitions if necessary, and work certificates) via Jobup.

Nach dem sogenannten Ansatz der integrierten Versorgung stellt diese innovative Organisation eine Chance für Gesundheitsfachkräfte dar, in kleinen multidisziplinären Teams zu arbeiten, um eine bessere Kontinuität der Versorgung zu gewährleisten und auf die Gesundheitsbedürfnisse der Bevölkerung des Pays-d’Enhaut einzugehen. Im Herzen einer privilegierten natürlichen Umgebung ist das Pays-d’Enhaut bekannt für die hohe Lebensqualität und bietet eine Vielzahl von sportlichen, Freizeit- und Kulturaktivitäten, die im Sommer wie im Winter genossen werden können! Im Rahmen unserer Ausbildungseinrichtung laden wir interessierte Assistenzärzte ein, sich über diese Anzeige zu bewerben. • Assicurare la trasmissione rigorosa e la documentazione delle informazioni necessarie per monitorare le situazioni

• Promuovere l'assistenza domestica e sostenere l'autonomia beneficiaria

• Partecipare, in multidisciplinarità, all'organizzazione e al follow-up del progetto di cura definito con il cliente

• HES-SO Bachelor in Infermieristica o Swiss Red Cross Recognition Diploma

• CAS in salute mentale o formazione ritenuto equivalente;

• 2 anni di esperienza nel campo psichiatrico

• Capacità di ascolto, autonomia e capacità di gestire situazioni complesse

• Proattività e facilità nel networking

• Mastery di strumenti informatici comuni

• Patenti di guida e veicoli essenziali

• Conoscenza della cura della casa: un bene
Offriamo:

• Partecipazione allo sviluppo di un modello di assistenza integrata, che coinvolge il coordinamento e la collaborazione di diversi operatori sanitari

• Lavoro in un ambiente piacevole, all'interno di una struttura di dimensioni umane

• I vantaggi di vivere in montagna rimanendo vicino ai centri urbani (da scoprire sotto www.alpesvaudoises.ch/en/stories/ paysdenhaut)

descriptionByLocale.en:
Located at 1000 meters above sea level, the Country-D-Enhaut Health Centre offers a wide range of hospital services, accommodation, accompaniment for the elderly and home care. According to the so-called integrated care approach, this innovative organization represents an opportunity for health professionals to work in small multidisciplinary teams, for better continuity of care and in response to the health needs of the population of the Upper Country.
In the heart of a privileged natural environment, less than an hour away from Lausanne or Bern, the Pays-d'Enhaut is renowned for its quality of life and offers a very wide range of sports, leisure and cultural activities, to live summer and winter!
For its Home Care Sector, the Country Health Department is looking for a:

Mental Health Nurse (50-70%)

Entry into office: 1 December 2026
In principle within the home care sector, you will also have to carry out one-off missions within the accommodation and hospital sectors.
Your mission:

• Assess needs, develop and adapt care projects to changing circumstances

• Provide medical technical nursing and actively contribute to team dynamics

• Participation in follow-up B13 in collaboration with the professionals concerned

• Ensure appropriate care for people of all ages, in collaboration with their surroundings

• Ensure strict transmission and documentation of information necessary to monitor situations

• Promote home care and support beneficiary autonomy

• Participate, in multidisciplinarity, in the organisation and follow-up of the care project defined with the client
Your profile:

• HES-SO Bachelor in Nursing or Swiss Red Cross Recognition Diploma

• CAS in mental health or training deemed equivalent;

• 2 years experience in the psychiatric field

• Listening ability, autonomy and ability to manage complex situations

• Proactivity and ease in networking

• Mastery of common computer tools

• Driving licences and essential vehicles

• Knowledge of home care: an asset
We offer:

• Participation in the development of an integrated care model, involving the coordination and collaboration of different health professionals

• Work in a pleasant environment, within a human-sized structure

• The benefits of living in the mountains while remaining close to urban centres (to be discovered under www.alpesvaudoises.ch/en/stories/ paysdenhaut)

• Working conditions in accordance with the CLC san-vaud (13th salary, training, 5-6 weeks of vacation per year, etc...)
Please send us your complete file (CV, cover letter, diplomas and work certificates) on Jobup

• Hörfähigkeit, Autonomie und Fähigkeit, komplexe Situationen zu bewältigen
